slug: 2026-01-30 The Gambia charts a path to data-driven education with DHIS2

facts.fact: DHIS2's article says the Ministry of Basic and Secondary Education is itself shifting its data system from aggregate counts to individual-level learner tracking on DHIS2 for Education, in partnership with GPE, HISP and GPE KIX; no date is given, so the publication date is used.

systems.owner: Ministry of Basic and Secondary Education (MoBSE)
systems.tiers: not stated; School Report Cards viewed by principals and parents

note: Classed emis on the stated individual learner records with real-time enrolment, attendance and performance data. The document is a short summary that does not say who enters the records, when, at which school level or in how many schools, so no levels, kept or schools fact is taken.
